nodes.name: Create LINE Group Registry
nodes.notes: Assign existing Notion bearer credential. New groups are created as 停用 with no purpose; manually approve a group by setting 狀態=啟用 and 用途=工單通知. This simple version creates a row each time the OA receives a group message; later it can be changed to upsert by Group ID.
